Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 102.19 is moderate. SOFR measures secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.496 is the latest returned weekly observation for Oct 16, not a live reading. NFCI rose 0.006 from its prior weekly row but remains negative.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • The FOMC meets Oct 27-28. The Board's October calendar lists a 2:00 PM decision/meeting entry and a 2:30 PM press conference Wed Oct 28; both are High impact per the local classifier.
  • Selected Board statistical releases verified against each item's own day list: H.6 today Oct 27 at 1:00 PM; H.4.1 Thu Oct 29 at 4:30 PM; H.8 Fri Oct 30 at 4:15 PM. H.10 was Oct 26 and is elapsed; not carried into the live calendar.
  • BEA currently lists third-quarter advance GDP and September Personal Income and Outlays both Thu Oct 29 at 8:30 AM. The New York Fed calendar separately lists GDP and Personal Income/PCE Deflator at the same time; these publisher dates agree. This corrects the previous briefing's apparent Nov 4 date conflict.
  • Chicago Fed's release calendar schedules NFCI for Oct 28, week ending Oct 23. The latest value actually returned in the Chicago Fed series is -0.496 for week ending Oct 16; the Oct 23 observation is not yet in the returned data.
Omissions and Watch
  • Coverage is selected, not exhaustive, and limited to checked primary sources. BLS.gov was not requested; BLS release dates/times use the New York Fed calendar. CPI and PPI are distinct: the checked November calendar lists CPI Nov 10 (High) and PPI Nov 13 (Medium); Employment Situation is Nov 6 (High). No CPI, PPI or Employment Situation is scheduled on the Oct 27-30 calendars checked.
  • Calendar conflict check: New York Fed lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Oct 29 at 8:30 AM, while the current BEA schedule gives Personal Income and Outlays, September 2026, at that same time. The schedules agree; the earlier Nov 4 conflict claim is not supported by the current BEA schedule. The current BEA schedule places U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services, September, on Nov 4; it is not a Personal Income/PCE release.
  • Dallas Fed says Texas Retail Outlook Survey results stopped after Jan 2026, so the obsolete New York Fed Texas Retail Outlook entry is omitted. Dallas Fed's current Texas Service Sector Outlook Survey schedule lists Oct 27 at 9:30 AM CT (10:30 AM ET); that is the active event shown. Richmond survey timing is sourced to the New York Fed date-specific calendar. Consumer Confidence is likewise shown from the New York Fed calendar; its period is not stated there.
  • EIA petroleum and natural-gas pages provide standard weekly schedules and exception dates, but no event-specific confirmation for Oct 28-29 was retrieved; no EIA event is inferred from cadence. Energy watch: overnight WTI $100.77, down 0.97% from Monday's completed bar; monitor energy sensitivity without assuming a cause. No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run.
  • Chicago Fed NFCI, Census releases, TreasuryDirect auctions, Federal Reserve Board statistical-release day lists, New York Fed October/November calendars, BEA schedule, Dallas Fed survey schedule, Treasury daily yield data and SOFR were checked. The Chicago Fed CFNAI release was Oct 26 at 8:30 AM and is elapsed before this cutoff. No exchange-specific market-structure event or product-hours review was verified. Confirm contract month, exchange hours, liquidity and event updates before execution; this calendar is not a review of unscheduled risks.
  • The local impact classifier self-test passed. Provisional unmatched Medium events are flagged in-row for review; they are not silently treated as Low.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Monday's SPY close rose 0.71%, and ES=F is 0.14% above Monday's completed session in the early Tuesday overnight quote. The official 10Y close is unchanged at 5.00%; MOVE 102.19 remains in the moderate-uncertainty band. Treat futures prices as overnight context, not settlement. The FOMC decision/press conference is Wed; GDP and PCE data are Thu at 8:30 AM. Monitor live yields, volatility, depth and the selected contract; this is scenario framing, not a directional forecast or trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES sustains a range break without confirmation from live Treasury yields, volatility and market depth; if the selected contract's hours differ; or if official event schedules change. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Reconfirm live quotes, auction/event updates and contract details before execution.
